name: Vendor privacy intake and triage
description: Procurement routes any vendor handling personal data through privacy intake before signature.

name: Data processing terms before signature
description: Acme requires signed processor terms or equivalent contractual privacy clauses before personal data is shared.

name: Transfer impact assessment and SCC review
description: Privacy reviews restricted transfers, verifies the mechanism, and documents supplementary measures before activation.

name: Least-data vendor configuration
description: Business owners limit vendor fields, roles, and exports to the minimum set needed for the service.

name: Termination deletion verification
description: Contracts require return or deletion at end of service and Acme collects deletion confirmation for higher-risk vendors.

name: Subprocessor change monitoring
description: Acme tracks vendor subprocessor notices and re-assesses high-risk changes before continued use.

name: Recorded meeting notice and host confirmation
description: Meeting hosts must inform participants before recording or transcription starts, state the purpose and retention, and offer a non-recorded alternative where required.

name: Short retention for recorded partner meetings
description: Recorded partner meetings and transcripts must have a short default retention period, restricted access, and a tested per-meeting deletion workflow.
